props.name: Source Text
props.expression: var word = comp("letters").layer("WORD CTRL").text.sourceText.toString().trim();var letterIndex = 3;var seed = 0;for (var s = 0; s < word.length; s++) {    seed = (seed * 31 + word.charCodeAt(s)) % 1000000;}var chars = word.split("");var order = [];for (var i = 0; i < chars.length; i++) {    order.push(i);}for (var j = order.length - 1; j > 0; j--) {    seed = (seed * 1664525 + 1013904223) % 4294967296;    var r = Math.floor((seed / 4294967296) * (j + 1));    var temp = order[j];    order[j] = order[r];    order[r] = temp;}var letter = "";if (letterIndex <= chars.length) {    letter = chars[order[letterIndex - 1]];}text.sourceText.style.setText(letter);

props.name: Scale
props.expression: amp = 0.08;     // bounce amountfreq = 1.0;     // bounce speeddecay = 6.0;    // how fast it stopsn = 0;if (numKeys > 0){    n = nearestKey(time).index;    if (key(n).time > time){        n--;    }}if (n == 0){    value;}else{    t = time - key(n).time;    v = velocityAtTime(key(n).time - thisComp.frameDuration/10);    value + v * amp * Math.sin(freq * t * 2 * Math.PI) / Math.exp(decay * t);}

props.expression: var word = thisComp.layer("WORD CTRL")    .text.sourceText.toString();var count = Math.min(word.length, 6);var letterIndex = 1;// Width of each boxvar boxWidth = 114;// Gap between boxesvar gap = 8;var spacing = boxWidth + gap;// Center all boxesvar centerX = thisComp.width / 2;var x = centerX +    (letterIndex - (count + 1) / 2) * spacing;[x, value[1]];
